tools.name: browser_workspace
tools.description: Show your active browsers and saved sessions in a workspace beside the conversation. Does not allocate or connect a browser. Optionally show a connected browser and its current screenshot. Use the sessionId and address from the selected browser to continue work.

tools.name: resume_saved_session
tools.description: Resume an existing saved session owned by the connected account. Reuses an active browser with the label, otherwise opens one metered browser with a 180-second idle timeout, restoring cookies and storage, not tabs. Only call after the user requests resume. Never retry an ambiguous allocation or chan

tools.name: open_browser
tools.description: Open one remote browser in the cloud with the connected CloudBrowser account. Use it only for websites and accounts that the user owns or is authorized to use, and follow their terms. Browsers open without stealth fingerprints.

tools.name: start_remote_desktop
tools.description: Start remote desktop access to a browser

tools.name: stop_remote_desktop
tools.description: Stop remote desktop access to a browser

tools.name: connect_to_browser
tools.description: Connect to CloudBrowser browser for direct control

tools.name: navigate_to_url
tools.description: Navigate the connected browser to a URL that the user asked for. Use it only for websites and accounts that the user owns or is authorized to use, and follow their terms. Stop at logins, MFA and CAPTCHAs and hand control to the user; this tool does not solve CAPTCHAs.

tools.name: get_page_content
tools.description: Get the HTML content of the current page to answer the user's request about it. Use it only for websites and accounts that the user owns or is authorized to use, and follow their terms. Not for crawling or bulk data extraction from third-party websites.

tools.name: get_elements
tools.description: Get information about elements matching a selector

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Take screenshot of the current page

tools.name: disconnect_browser
tools.description: Disconnect this control session from a browser. The browser keeps running; use close_browser to stop it.

tools.name: get_connected_browsers
tools.description: List the browsers that this caller has connected for direct control

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "resume_saved_session" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
